criteria.description: Provisional eligibility for candidates whose qualifying-degree results are yet to be declared: all parts of the examination must be completed before joining and the passing marksheet/certificate is due latest by October 31, 2025.
criteria.raw_quote: Selection of applicants whose results in the qualifying degree examination are yet to be declared will be provisional, subject to the condition that all parts of the examination must be completed in all respects before the date of joining the Institute and the marksheet/certificate as evidence of passing the qualifying examination is to be submitted latest by October 31, 2025.
criteria.reason: Candidate is_appearing=true with expected_completion_date 2026-07-31, which is after the printed marksheet deadline 2025-10-31. Results cannot be evidenced by the deadline required to join the 2025-26 session -> NOT_MET.

criteria.description: Applicants must qualify in a GATE paper appropriate to the discipline of the qualifying degree (CS/DA/EC/EE acceptable for CSE-range courses at IIT Kharagpur). The brochure prints no explicit GATE year window; for the 2025-26 session the usable years are GATE-2024/2025 under the standard three-year score validity.
criteria.raw_quote: Applicants must qualify in a GATE paper appropriate to the discipline of their qualifying degree if a GATE paper is available in such a discipline. Only for those disciplines where there is no relevant GATE paper, XE/XL/XH papers of the GATE examination is applicable.
criteria.reason: GATE-2026 CS record: 2026 is the next admission cycle (results arrive in 2026), not in the usable window [2024, 2025] for the 2025-26 session -> NOT_MET.
